physics.scope: Within each native GIZMO variant, actual historical tanh versus sharp velocity. Regular equal-volume initial lattice, variable masses, original float32 IC/output precision and fully periodic native boundary recipe. Native kernel-derived density/pressure must be checked separately. No passive material tracer is assumed; particle-ID mass in MFV is not a material-retention diagnostic.

mass_account.criterion: Predeclared engineering accumulation gate, not a physical accuracy theorem.

finished.scope: Mass diagnostics; native velocities staggered, periodic box, not a cross-code equivalence or physical-accuracy proof.
